title: VoidCode runtime config
description: Workspace-local VoidCode runtime configuration. Stored at `.voidcode.json` in the workspace root. Resolves alongside environment variables (VOIDCODE_APPROVAL_MODE, VOIDCODE_MODEL, VOIDCODE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, VOIDCODE_REASONING_EFFORT) and the user-level `~/.config/voidcode/config.json`.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

config_schema_version.description: Top-level config schema version. Currently only 1 is supported; omit to default to 1.

components.description: Installed components selected for this runtime.

approval_mode.description: Default approval policy mode for tool execution: which tool tiers are auto-approved.

execution_engine.description: Execution engine used when no request or environment override is set.

fallback_models.description: Ordered fallback models tried after the primary model.

tool_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout applied to each tool execution.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional runtime-owned reasoning-effort hint forwarded to the active provider when supported (for example, 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Runtime rejects this hint when the resolved model explicitly does not support reasoning effort.

hooks.description: Runtime-managed lifecycle hooks (pre/post tool, session, background).

formatter.description: Formatting behavior exposed as a top-level user-facing capability.

providers.description: Provider-level configuration. Credential fields are sensitive; prefer environment variables for secrets.

background_task.description: Background task queue and concurrency limits.

reminders.description: Runtime-injected per-call reminders for an active session (default on).

agentMcpBindingConfig.description: Declarative MCP profile/server binding intent for this agent. Runtime MCP config, lifecycle, approval, and tool allowlists remain authoritative.

prompt_profile.description: Prompt/profile selection for this agent entry.

prompt.description: Explicit prompt/profile text for this agent config entry.

prompt_append.description: Additional local guidance appended to the resolved base prompt.

fallback_models.description: Agent-scoped fallback model chain; requires agent.model.

summary_enabled.description: Opt-in model-generated compaction summary. Off by default. When on, the compaction summary comes from a provider call and falls back to the deterministic projection if that call fails.

provider_context_diagnostics.description: Runtime policy for provider-context diagnostics before provider execution. 'warn' emits bounded metadata, 'block' fails selected high-severity diagnostics before the provider call, and 'off' keeps diagnostics debug-only.

provider_context_oversized_feedback_char.description: Character threshold for oversized retained tool feedback diagnostics.

context_transform_failure_policy.description: Policy for failed context transform providers. 'ignore' keeps failures as debug metadata only, 'warn' surfaces warning diagnostics without blocking provider execution, and 'block' turns transform failures into blocking provider-context diagnostics.

compaction.description: Bounded pruning of tool-result content when the estimated provider payload reaches the budget threshold.

format_on_write.description: Opt-in auto-format after edit/write. Off by default. 'enabled' is kept as the existing alias and maps onto the same format-on-write switch (it no longer disables all hooks).

installedComponentSelection.description: One installed component explicitly selected for runtime composition.

diagnostics_on_write.description: Opt-in automatic LSP diagnostics after edit/write. Off by default. Does not gate the explicit 'lsp' tool.

url.description: Remote HTTP MCP endpoint URL. Required when transport is remote-http.

rules.description: Ordered runtime permission rules for tool/path/command matches. First matching rule applies after hard tool allowlist and external-directory gates.

tool.description: Tool name glob, for example read, grep, or shell_exec.

path.description: Workspace-relative or canonical path glob for filesystem-related tool calls.

command.description: Shell command glob used by shell_exec rules.

remindersConfig.description: Runtime-owned per-call reminders injected into an active session.

localToolsConfig.description: Opt-in workspace-local custom tool manifest discovery. Runtime executes discovered command tools through the normal registry, allowlist, and permission path.

essential_only.description: Essential/discoverable tool split: when true, only the essential tool set (plus allowlist-required tools) is sent top-level to the provider; the rest stay registered and reachable on demand.

commandList.description: Array of commands; each command is a non-empty argv array of strings. Commands are executed directly without an implicit shell.

permissionRules.description: Ordered path-glob permission map. First matching pattern applies.
